text:
The 1960 deed gave the friend a fee simple subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25. That executory interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities: church use might occur, and a child might reach 25, more than 21 years after every life in being at the conveyance. Striking the void interest leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute; later births and deaths do not revive it.

CONFIDENCE: 78
